decisions.reason: Positive quantified savings and centrality to the announced modular direction make dropping this publicly committed, heavily invested product very unlikely.
Its own-page visibility and two years of investment create public commitment and sunk costs that management will likely justify by keeping it despite less prominent results.
The strong quantified customer savings and specific reference case reinforce the central modular concept, making management highly unlikely to abandon this committed investment.
As a recently launched product with its own page, any disappointing results can still be attributed to temporary causes, so management will likely persist.
The recent launch and visible public commitment mean little has been written off, but the firm will likely keep it to justify the new investment and give it time to prove itself.
